rules.name: google-font-display
rules.description: Enforce font-display behavior with Google Fonts.

rules.name: google-font-preconnect
rules.description: Ensure `preconnect` is used with Google Fonts.

rules.name: inline-script-id
rules.description: Enforce `id` attribute on `next/script` components with inline content.

rules.name: next-script-for-ga
rules.description: Prefer `@next/third-parties/google` when using the inline script for Google Analytics and Tag Manager.

rules.name: no-assign-module-variable
rules.description: Prevent assignment to the `module` variable.

rules.name: no-async-client-component
rules.description: Prevent Client Components from being async functions.

rules.name: no-before-interactive-script-outside-document
rules.description: Prevent usage of `next/script`'s `beforeInteractive` strategy outside of `pages/_document.js`.

rules.name: no-css-tags
rules.description: Prevent manual stylesheet tags.

rules.name: no-document-import-in-page
rules.description: Prevent importing `next/document` outside of `pages/_document.js`.

rules.name: no-duplicate-head
rules.description: Prevent duplicate usage of `<Head>` in `pages/_document.js`.

rules.name: no-head-element
rules.description: Prevent usage of `<head>` element.

rules.name: no-head-import-in-document
rules.description: Prevent usage of `next/head` in `pages/_document.js`.

rules.name: no-html-link-for-pages
rules.description: Prevent usage of `<a>` elements to navigate to internal Next.js pages.

rules.name: no-img-element
rules.description: Prevent usage of `` element due to slower LCP and higher bandwidth.

rules.name: no-location-assign-relative-destination
rules.description: Prevent usage of `location.assign` or `location.href` assignment to navigate to internal Next.js pages.

rules.name: no-page-custom-font
rules.description: Prevent page-only custom fonts.

rules.name: no-script-component-in-head
rules.description: Prevent usage of `next/script` in `next/head` component.

rules.name: no-styled-jsx-in-document
rules.description: Prevent usage of `styled-jsx` in `pages/_document.js`.

rules.name: no-sync-scripts
rules.description: Prevent synchronous scripts.

rules.name: no-title-in-document-head
rules.description: Prevent usage of `<title>` with `Head` component from `next/document`.

rules.name: no-typos
rules.description: Prevent common typos in Next.js data fetching functions.

rules.name: no-unwanted-polyfillio
rules.description: Prevent duplicate polyfills from Polyfill.io.
